description: This file defines an ApiClient class in Dart for handling HTTP communication with a backend API. It includes methods for GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE requests, utilizing environment variables for configuration and handling responses with error checking.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A client for making HTTP requests to a backend API, supporting GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE methods with configurable base URL via environment variables.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for API request failures.

methods.name: ApiClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the HTTP client and resolving the base URL from environment variables.

methods.name: _resolveBaseUrl
methods.description: Static method that determines the base URL for API requests, defaulting to localhost if not specified in environment variables.

methods.name: _uri
methods.description: Constructs a Uri object from a path and optional query parameters, combining it with the base URL.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified path with optional query parameters.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to the specified path with an optional body.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request to the specified path with an optional body.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the specified path.

methods.name: _headers
methods.description: Returns standard headers for JSON content type and accept.

methods.name: _decode
methods.description: Decodes the HTTP response body from JSON, or returns null if empty.

methods.name: _ensureSuccess
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP response status code indicates success; throws ApiException otherwise.

methods.name: throwIfNoop
methods.description: Helper method to satisfy the 'Never' return type; should always throw.
